meta.name: central-dome-core-wireframe
meta.designIntent: Central Complex core only: broad facade, ceremonial portico, center hall mass, drum, great dome, and short east-west shoulder masses where later north-south wings will attach. Dome stack sits low and rearward behind the attic band; no long courtyard wings yet.
